_help: Hand-checked numbers win over scraped ones. Key = IPO slug as shown in docs/data/ipos.json. Fields: issue_price, lot_size, net_qib_shares (EX-anchor, from RHP / Basis of Allotment), qib_times (final, from registrar's Basis of Allotment), listing_price. To add an IPO the scraper missed, also give name, open_date, close_date, listing_date.
